name: nexo-apps
description: Nexo Apps: an adapted application factory based on Eric Tech's super-board pack.

plugins.name: nexo-apps
plugins.description: Autonomous GitHub Project board runner: super-board, super-build, super-qa, super-review, super-collect, visual, git-sync, ui-refine-loop, pr-security-review (security pass on every PR; onboard adds Cloudflare's on-demand security-audit). After install, run /super-board onboard to add the guard hooks, .claude/bin scripts and workflows a plugin cannot ship.
